targets.name: job-store
targets.rationale: Job state transitions back long-running route behavior and must not silently regress.

targets.name: path-resolution
targets.rationale: Path validation is a security boundary; mutation survivors are treated as high-priority signal.

targets.name: registry
targets.rationale: Registry contracts define node/API surface area and should be resistant to subtle branch mutations.

targets.name: output-assembler
targets.rationale: The OUTPUT assembler is the schema-determined cut planner + serialiser behind the {frames + field-map} -> JSON boundary (D13); its branch decisions are data-independent and must not silently regress. Witnesses kill every non-equivalent survivor; the residual ~9% floor is all equivalent mutants — union-find loop bounds that path-compression self-repairs, set-difference '-' -> '^' where the subtrahend is provably a subset, synthesised-gather predicate errors that _prune absorbs to empty objects, fast-path index/count variants whose slow path generalises identically, interned-string 'is', grp[0]-under-grouping, and the two frozen-dataclass decorators.

targets.name: jsonpath
targets.rationale: The single-sourced path-grammar core (PATH_GRAMMAR.md) — acceptance, canonicality, and the canonical writer. Both INPUT and OUTPUT depend on it, so subtle branch mutations are high-priority signal. Residual survivors are five equivalent mutants: '==' -> 'is' on single-char (interned) dispatch, '<' -> '!='/'is not' on a loop bound that never overshoots, and '==' -> '>=' on the canonical-writer round-trip (a canonical re-emit never lexically exceeds its input).

targets.name: json-shred
targets.rationale: The v2 JSON shred/codec — relational decomposition of an array-outer document into per-table buffers; the inverse of the OUTPUT assembler and the load-bearing half of the round-trip invariant. Measured survival 2.32% (25/1079: 660 killed, 393 pragma'd-equivalent skipped) after re-witnessing the W1/W2 fail-loud drift (earlier documented baseline 4.69%). The W1 conservation/fail-loud pass (5297a30b) and the W2 shared-helper pass added branches with no discriminating witness; the two hand-edited-config validators are now witnessed directly — _reject_reserved_leaf_collision (a '$value' scalar leaf sharing a table's own array depth with a real sibling) and _reject_unexpressible_key (a source key equal to '$value' or containing '.'), each pinned with a NON-interned sentinel copy so the '==' -> 'is' identity mutation is killed — and the depth-0 value terminator now has a whitespace-before-comma witness ('b == b","' vs 'b <= b","', since a space 0x20 <= comma 0x2c). Witnesses kill every non-equivalent survivor; the residual floor is equivalent or out-of-scope-for-unit-witnessing mutants in these classes: (1) parser byte-compares '==' -> 'is' on the single-byte reader, where CPython caches single-byte bytes singletons so 'is' is identical to '==' over the reachable one-byte domain; (2) bounded-domain comparison swaps ('==' -> '<='/'>=', '<' -> '!='/'is not', '>' -> '!=') against a bound the operand provably cannot cross — byte ordinals within a known set, depth >= 0, lengths >= 1, sample counters that never overshoot, set cardinalities, and interned small-int array depths ('d is own_depth'); (3) the redundant 2-tuple column sort key '(path or "", name or "")', where mutating either 'or' leaves the other tuple element to canonicalise a stable order; (4) the streaming-reader whitespace/depth guard whose inversion makes the loop hang rather than emit wrong output, killable only by wall-clock timeout (which Cosmic Ray does not record as an assertion kill); (5) the atomic cache-swap teardown / temp-dir cleanup error-recovery branches reachable only by injected filesystem faults, exercised by the durability/integration suite rather than the per-mutant codec-logic test-set; (6) the single-pass conservation assertion — a defensive 'emitted + skipped == records' internal-consistency guard whose loop/subset-test/continue never fire on a valid config and whose arithmetic fires only on a scalar-root-table-fed-object-records shape a valid pipeline never produces, its behaviour covered by the round-trip property suite; and (7) unreachable-else defaults a real build always populates — the cache-noop 'skipped' fallback and the single-frame 'bundle[emit_labels[0]]' index. Annotation-only '|' unions — including the function-local 'str | None' variable annotation in infer_v2_schema_from_data, which Python never evaluates — keyword-only '*,' markers, and cosmetic log-field truncation slices are pragma'd (skipped). Where an equivalent-mutant line is too long to carry an inline '# pragma: no mutate' under the 100-col limit (the fingerprint sort key, an interned-'$value' compare in _emit_at/_walk_array), the survivor is accepted rather than pragma'd.

targets.name: json-cache
targets.rationale: The v2 per-port JSON cache route (build/status/cancel/progress/infer/delete) — the orchestration layer over the json-shred codec. Measured survival 9.65% (30/311: 214 killed, 66 pragma'd-equivalent skipped) after witnessing the directly-callable helper layer: path-traversal/null-byte resolution (enforce_project_root + the 400/403 status contract), build-progress accounting (active_count/+1/-1/<=0/rows/elapsed), and build+status aggregation defaults. The residual is (a) equivalent/bounded mutants — annotation '|' unions (pragma'd), unreachable '.get(x, 0)' defaults where the key is always present, 'range(int(...))' 0->-1 (empty either way), rounding-precision and timeout-message cosmetics, and the '<=0'/'-1'/'+1' arms whose mutated value still lands on the same pop decision over the reachable active-count domain; and (b) handler-body mutants in the FastAPI endpoints (the build-timeout message math, the except-Exception 500 catch-alls, the GET-status 'v2_config is None' branch, the build elapsed timing) reachable only through TestClient, exercised by the route integration suites (test_json_cache_*.py) rather than these unit witnesses.

targets.name: executor
targets.rationale: The graph executor — runs a React Flow pipeline graph as a live Polars pipeline (preview, materialisation, caching, sandboxed user code). Measured survival 13.43% (210/1564: 782 killed, 572 pragma'd-equivalent skipped). All 572 skipped are annotation-only '|' unions (under 'from __future__ import annotations', never evaluated). Witnesses kill the directly-callable helper layer: _pipeline_dir's 'Path.cwd() / p' path-join (any arithmetic mutation raises TypeError on Path operands), the _is_dangerous_preamble_binding sandbox 'or' chain (or->and would clear a dangerous submodule import — a sandbox-escape regression), _preview_row_limit_for_width's negative-guard and cell-budget floor-division, and _cache_has_required_materialization's required-columns subset gate (inverting '<=' would treat an incomplete cache as complete). The residual is (a) equivalent mutants — the 'split(".", 1)' max-splits arg (the [0] element is unchanged), bounded-domain comparison arms, interned-string/enum '==' -> 'is', the '64 * 1024 * 1024' streaming-size and 'lru_cache(maxsize=128)' tuning constants, and telemetry '.get(nid, 0)' defaults; and (b) branch-decision mutants inside the ~700-line 'execute_graph' body (node-type dispatch, preview-column matching, error-count and truncation flags, set-difference staleness) exercised by the executor integration suites (test_executor*.py, test_preview_cache_*.py) but not asserted at the mutation-discriminating level — witnessing those requires constructed-graph execution tests (a documented follow-up), not unit witnesses.
